digest.component_or_area: pytest test selection and CI workflow
propositions: Nineteen OS/Python-invariant repository-policy test nodes are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) with identical selectors.
These 19 immutable AST and repository text inspection nodes should execute exactly once in the Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process only, not in other platform variants.

Marked nodes must be excluded from non-primary default selections via `and not repo_policy` appended to the shared workflow selector, while unmarked behavior in mixed modules retains original routing.
The repo_policy marker must be registered as strict and applied only at function level to the exact 19 inventoried test cases, preserving runtime and subprocess test coverage on all platforms.

Workflow parity contract verification must prove that marked and non-marked subsets partition the seven mixed modules correctly, the four-cell matrix remains intact, and exactly two pytest sessions exist.
